name: SVR Poker Android
nextApkDrop: Only after the Android web game passes a stable playtest batch.
notes: Do not force testers to update the APK every phase.
Use the stable Android web route for ongoing game logic and UX updates.

Phase 338 preserves Phase 332 chip physics, Phase 333 shaders and controls, Phase 334 table and gesture layout, Phase 335 Oculus stability, Phase 336 authoritative rules, and Phase 337 physical pot settlement.
Phase 338 makes the player's visible unlocked chips equal the exact authoritative bankroll after every bet, call, raise, all-in, win, split pot, and bust-out.
Phase 338 reuses the existing Quest-safe 32-chip physical pool and dynamically assigns $1, $5, $25, $100, $500, $1,000, and $5,000 denominations.
Phase 338 preserves held and thrown chip values, reserves working change for normal calls and raises, and reclaims committed chips only after winner settlement.
Phase 338 adds bankroll gain/loss transit animation, a ledger-matched bankroll display, busted-player presentation, and deterministic bankroll model tests.
Quest/Oculus gameplay remains on the WebXR route; Android keeps its stable touch-first route.
Director preview remains separate and must contain no Android controls or visible runtime overlays.
Build a new native APK only when native app code, package, permissions, signing, icon, WebView shell, or release channel changes.
